Zoe (Marketing Ops): Morning — spike in webinar signups caused ~22 leads to land in the generic fallback because enrichment didn't finish before claim logic ran. Hitting our SLA.

Hector (Sales Ops): Oof. Do we know why those enrichments delayed? Attachments or large profiles?

Zoe (Marketing Ops): Mostly long form + attachments. Enrichment service returning 202 then PATCH to HS after ~8-11s. Example: lead 9123 had PATCH at +10.4s.

Mina (Platform Eng): Current behavior: claim window = 4s, if enrichment not present RR skips. Two approaches: (A) increase claim window for all traffic, or (B) soft-hold owner assignment called `TempHold` and reassign when enrichment completes.

Jon (Growth): I prefer soft-hold so reps get visibility but outreach suppressed until final owner set. Keeps notification latency low.

Hector (Sales Ops): Agree, but add a visible lead property so reps can filter. Also prevent task creation while `temphold=true`.

Mina (Platform Eng): Proposed config change: 
```
CLAIM_WINDOW_MS=4000
ENABLE_TEMPHOLD_ASSIGN=true
TEMPHOLD_OWNER=TempHold
TEMPHOLD_FLAG=temphold
TEMPHOLD_TTL_SEC=1800
SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS_WHILE_FLAG=true
WAIT_FOR_ENRICH_MS=10000
```
Flow: immediately assign to TempHold, wait up to 10s for enrichment. If enrichment arrives and RR picks rep -> reassign and append note "Auto-finalized after enrichment (prev TempHold)". If not, keep TempHold until TTL.

Zoe (Marketing Ops): Add metric `lead.temphold.count` and `lead.temphold.finalized_rate`. Want alerts if >5% of daily leads are TempHold.

Hector (Sales Ops): For SFDC: route TempHold to `Temp Leads` queue, exclude from outbound cadence, and hide from SDR active lists. I'll draft rule and share.

leadflow-bot: deploy scheduled: lead-router -> staging (build #1478).

Mina (Platform Eng): Canary plan — 600 synthetic leads, 35% with attachments, run at 2:15pm PT. Capture: percent_tempheld, finalize_rate, avg_time-to-finalize, dup-notify-count. Thresholds: finalize_rate > 88%, dup-notify < 4%.

Jon (Growth): Also capture sample ids for audit (e.g., 9123, 9156, 9230) and a short screencast of the flow for SDRs.

Zoe (Marketing Ops): Timeline: staging change now, canary 2:15pm, review 3:30pm, prod 9pm if green. Mina will own rollback (disable TEMPHOLD, restore claim window). Please post dashboard links and sample ids here after the run.

Hector (Sales Ops): I'll prep an internal note explaining TempHold behavior for reps and include filter snippets for HS & SFDC.

Zoe (Marketing Ops): Thanks team — let's keep the rollout tight. Morning spikes are our pain point :pray:
